assumptions.choice: Backtest on available ~6 year dataset provided by execution harness.
assumptions.reason: The specification mentions backtesting over at least 10 years, but the execution environment provides 1507 daily bars (2020-2025).

assumptions.choice: Treat market return, tax rate, interest rate, and inflation rate calculations as descriptive theoretical context rather than live daily broker cash deductions.
assumptions.reason: The spec provides explicit interest/tax/inflation metrics to illustrate expected net returns, but does not specify a daily custom broker cash debit mechanism.

assumptions.choice: Calculate 5-year holding period as 1825 calendar days (5 * 365 days) from entry date.
assumptions.reason: Using calendar date difference cleanly reflects a 5-year physical holding threshold.

assumptions.choice: Rebalance 365 calendar days after the entry date or last rebalance date.
assumptions.reason: 365 calendar days matches standard annual rebalancing intervals.
